description: This file defines an interface for generating idempotency keys for external events within the Fineract infrastructure. It declares a generic method that takes a BusinessEvent and returns its corresponding idempotency key as a string.

classes.name: ExternalEventIdempotencyKeyGenerator
classes.description: A Java interface that declares a method for generating idempotency keys based on BusinessEvent instances.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a string idempotency key for the given BusinessEvent.
